"anim" : "fadedrop", "dur" : 300 }, "items" : "voidanim" } } } The Third Annual Best Rosé in Thailand at The Nai Harn Phuket Thursday, June 7, 2018
We held our third annual Best Rosé in Thailand at The Nai Harn Phuket on Friday, May 11. A Thai wine, the 2017 Monsoon Valley White Shiraz received three awards: Best of Show, Best Value and No. 1 of Top 10 Rosé. It joins the Billecart-Salmon Champagne Brut Rosé NV , which received the Best of Show award in the sparkling section of the competition. Almost 100 rosés were rated by James and Jack Suckling in a blind tasting. The wine entries were limited to those that are available in the Thai market only and most of them were submitted by the importers of Thailand. In this video, you'll find all the event highlights. Everyone had a great time tasting the array of rosés and small bites at Reflections Rooftop Bar . Hope to see you all again next year!
*The video was originally published on The Nai Harn Phuket's YouTube Channel on May 17, 2018. SHARE ON: Comment is required for submission! Leave comment
